title: Western
story: A sunny day out on the wide open frontier.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A cowboy hat with a wide brim curled up on both sides, a tall crown with a center crease, and a band around the base of the crown, symmetrical from the front.
cards.hero_colors: tan brown with a red band

cards.name: Lasso
cards.subject: A lasso: a coiled rope ending in a wide open loop with a sliding knot, and a cord wrapped around the coil.
cards.hero_colors: tan rope with a red cord wrapped around the coil

cards.name: Bandana
cards.subject: A bandana: a smooth triangle of cloth with a small knot at the top and a pattern of round dots.
cards.hero_colors: red with white dots and a small yellow knot

cards.name: Cowboy Boot
cards.subject: A cowboy boot standing upright with a tall shaft, a pointed toe, a slanted heel, and a star stitched on the shaft.
cards.hero_colors: brown leather with a yellow star on the shaft

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A saguaro cactus with one tall trunk, two arms bending upward, one on each side, and a flower on top, growing from the sand.
cards.hero_colors: green with a pink flower on top

cards.name: Horseshoe
cards.subject: A horseshoe shaped like a symmetrical rounded U with seven nail holes along the curve, lying flat on the ground.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey steel with golden nails in the holes

cards.name: Covered Wagon
cards.subject: A wooden wagon with four spoked wheels, the rear pair bigger, and an arched white canvas cover over the box, standing on the ground.
cards.hero_colors: white canvas, brown wooden body, with red wheels

cards.name: Windmill
cards.subject: A farm windmill: a tall tapering four-sided tower with solid walls, a round wheel of many blades at the top, and a tail vane behind the wheel.
cards.hero_colors: grey tower and white blades with a red tail vane

cards.name: Mesa
cards.subject: A mesa: a tall flat-topped rock butte with steep layered sides, standing alone on the desert floor.
cards.hero_colors: red-orange rock with a few green desert shrubs at the base

cards.name: Campfire Pals
cards.subject: The man in a cowboy hat stirs a pot of beans over a small campfire while the pig sniffs the steam with a big happy smile.
cards.hero_colors: brown hat, pink pig, black pot, orange fire
